* interface for classes implementing algorithms modeled similar to the Digital Signature Alorithm.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public void init(boolean forSigning, CipherParameters param)
methods.comment:
* initialise the signer for signature generation or signature
     * verification.
     *
     * @param forSigning true if we are generating a signature, false
     * otherwise.
     * @param param key parameters for signature generation.

methods.name: public BigInteger[] generateSignature(byte[] message)
methods.comment:
* sign the passed in message (usually the output of a hash function).
     *
     * @param message the message to be signed.
     * @return two big integers representing the r and s values respectively.

methods.name: public boolean verifySignature(byte[] message, BigInteger r, BigInteger s)
methods.comment:
* verify the message message against the signature values r and s.
     *
     * @param message the message that was supposed to have been signed.
     * @param r the r signature value.
     * @param s the s signature value.

methodNames: public void init(boolean forSigning, CipherParameters param)
public boolean verifySignature(byte[] message, BigInteger r, BigInteger s)
